recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-50647 unless the work group reopens the later FHIR-50911 Reference(Any) decision.
issue_request: FHIR-50647 was an Applied/Persuasive OO request for R6 to clarify Transport.focus as the physical entity being transported and to restrict the reference targets from Reference(Any) to a named list of transportable resource types.
initial_application: Commit 0eeb5718b2 applied the requested definition and replaced Reference(Resource) with a targetProfile list. Commit e9a73dbed7 removed Product from that list because Product is a pattern. Transport is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/transport/structuredefinition-Transport.xml is the current build source for the resource.
additional_context: OO WGM minutes confirm the original FHIR-50647 motion and 8-0-0 vote. Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-50911 explicitly changed Transport.focus and Transport.subject references back to Reference(Any), and commit 00dca87607 applied that later decision by restoring the Resource targetProfile while preserving the FHIR-50647 definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing the FHIR-50647 targetProfile restriction would conflict with the later FHIR-50911 applied decision, so the current source should remain unchanged.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification Transport cleanup explicitly changed Transport.focus and Transport.subject references to Reference(Any), superseding the FHIR-50647 target restriction.
